components.name: Browser session
components.description: Signs visitors in, keeps their login between requests and refreshes it when needed. Guests can also use this service.

components.name: Browser routes
components.description: Sends browser requests to Link, Account or Billing API. Proves which service is calling and passes on the signed-in user when there is one.

components.name: Verify user
components.description: Accepts guests and checks any user token supplied. Changing an owned link also requires permission from its owner.

components.name: Create, claim & edit
components.description: Creates and edits links and lets guests claim them. Returns the original result when a completed request is retried.

components.name: Reports & moderation
components.description: Accepts abuse reports. Only an authorized moderator can block or unblock a link.

components.name: Verify user
components.description: Requires a valid user login before returning account information.

components.name: My links
components.description: Lists the signed-in person's links, newest first.

components.name: Analytics & export
components.description: Checks who owns the link and what their plan allows. Returns click counts or prepares a CSV download.

components.name: Verify user
components.description: Requires a valid user login for customer billing and plan requests.

components.name: Plans & checkout
components.description: Shows the customer's plan or starts checkout. Opening the billing page does not start a payment.

components.name: Entitlements
components.description: Tells Link and Account API which features a customer can use. Records each successful use of an export allowance.

components.name: Reconcile payments
components.description: Checks for payment notices and unfinished checkouts on a schedule, even when nobody opens the billing page.

components.name: Verified payment event
components.description: Saves a payment notice before replying. Today QRWTY's edge must check Stripe's signature and sign the message for Jeeves.

components.name: Resolve & record click
components.description: Finds the destination, waits for the click to be saved, then checks the link is still valid before redirecting. A HEAD request records no click.

components.name: Route cache
components.description: Looks for a recent destination in Hot routes. On a miss, calls Route lookup and saves the result for the next visitor.

components.name: Route lookup
components.description: Reads the latest destination, status and expiry from Links when the cache needs a fresh copy.

components.name: Aggregate clicks
components.description: Saves the click ID and updates its count together. A second copy of the same message leaves the count alone.

components.name: Retention sweep
components.description: Deletes click IDs older than 35 days and daily totals older than 13 months. Runs even when no new clicks arrive.

system.name: QRWTY
system.description: QRWTY turns long URLs into short links and QR codes. Anyone can open a link. Creators can manage destinations, see clicks and pay for more features.

nodes.name: Visitor
nodes.description: Opens a short URL or scans its QR code.

nodes.name: Link creator
nodes.description: Creates links as a guest or signs in to manage links, analytics and plans.

nodes.name: Stripe
nodes.description: Sends a signed notice when a payment or subscription changes.

relationships.description: Opens a short link or QR code.
Creates and claims guest links, signs in, manages owned links, reads analytics and manages billing.
QRWTY checks Stripe's signature, then sends the verified notice to Stripe event inbox.

elements.name: Browser API
elements.description: Takes requests from the browser. Guests can create links. Signed-in users can manage links, view clicks and pay.

elements.name: Identity
elements.description: Issues the tokens that identify users and services. This diagram uses Keycloak. QRWTY uses Auth0 in staging.

elements.name: Sessions
elements.description: Keeps browser logins so a user stays signed in when a different copy of Browser API handles the next request.

elements.name: Link API
elements.description: Creates and edits short links, handles claims and abuse reports, and limits how often a guest can create a link.

elements.name: Account API
elements.description: Shows people their own links and click counts. Checks their plan before showing paid reports or exporting a file.

elements.name: Billing API
elements.description: Starts checkout, tracks subscriptions and tells other services what a customer's plan allows.

elements.name: Links
elements.description: Stores short links, destinations and their owners. Redirect can look up a destination. Only Link API can change it.

elements.name: Web Risk
elements.description: Google checks new destinations for unsafe URLs before QRWTY accepts them.

elements.name: Redirect
elements.description: Looks in Hot routes first. If the route is missing or too old, looks it up in Links. Records a click before sending the visitor on.

elements.name: Hot routes
elements.description: Keeps recently used destinations for up to 30 seconds. Reading one again does not extend its expiry.

elements.name: Click events
elements.description: Holds click messages until Click processor can count them. This project uses Google Cloud Pub/Sub.

elements.name: Click processor
elements.description: Counts each click once, even if the message arrives twice. Removes old records on a schedule.

elements.name: Analytics
elements.description: Stores click counts and the IDs already counted. Account API can read reports. Click processor writes them.

elements.name: Billing
elements.description: Stores subscriptions, usage and payment notices. The inbox can add a notice. Only Billing API can change a subscription.

elements.name: Stripe
elements.description: Hosts checkout and the customer portal. Sends payment updates back to QRWTY.

elements.name: Stripe event inbox
elements.description: Receives payment notices from Stripe. Replies after saving each notice so a retry or a restart won't lose it.

planned.label: Signs in and authenticates browser calls
Reads routes, fills on a miss
Publishes clicks and awaits the ACK

customRequirements.requirement: Guests create without login. Keep the sealed claim proof and idempotent result for 24 hours. Hash the trusted address prefix at the edge. Enforce guest admission and exact account quotas across copies.

Only Browser API owns the browser session and initiates login. Preserve the 24-hour idle and seven-day absolute limits. Session forwarding and machine identity are separate. The selected Keycloak contract requires an Auth0 integration decision.

Revoke sessions and durably track account deletion across owners. Disable owned links within 60 seconds, never reuse their slugs and reconcile subscription cancellation without retaining user credentials.

Eligible GET returns 302 only after confirmed durable publish and a final validity check. Unknown publish returns 503 without Location. HEAD emits no event. A route is valid for at most 30 seconds after its authoritative lookup.

Replay Pub/Sub for 31 days and deduplicate click IDs for 35 days. Commit the product effect with its receipt, ACK after commit, quarantine bad input and distinguish a stopped consumer from a true zero. The installed 30-day receipt limit leaves a gap.

The edge must verify the native Stripe signature on unchanged input up to 256 KiB. Canonicalize a bounded event, sign it for the Jeeves receiver and wait for its durable 202. Store the unique Stripe event for 35 days after success. Retain failed events until repaired.

Run test-mode Checkout and portal. A status read is side-effect free. Grants expire within 60 seconds. Reconcile pending events, stuck checkouts and uncertain Stripe effects. Downgrade never disables existing links.
New destinations require the Google Web Risk adapter. Stripe, Auth0 compatibility, trusted client addresses and the managed Pub/Sub archive are external integration work.
